full_prompt_en: A square anime illustration places two boys shoulder to shoulder against a simple warm beige background. The smaller boy at left has short unruly near-black hair, very large round green eyes, and a few freckles beneath each eye. He wears a red outer jacket over a pale gray collared shirt and dark necktie. His mouth is closed and his gaze lifts slightly to the right, suggesting concern or alertness. The taller boy at right stands a little behind him and occupies more of the frame. His orange-red spiky hair spreads outward in sharp layered locks and partly overlaps a dark red brimlike or headband shape above his forehead. He wears a dark teal jacket over a vivid ochre shirt, with a red tie and brown shoulder strap running diagonally down his chest. His eyebrows are set and his chin lifts, making his expression confident and challenging. Both are cropped around the upper torso. Their shoulders touch visually but neither gestures; the relationship is conveyed by close spacing and contrasting expressions. The left face is round and youthful, while the right is narrower and more angular. Clean dark contours define hair, eyes, collars, and jacket seams, with warm cel-style shadow planes on cheeks, necks, and clothing folds. Bright orange highlights flare through the right hair, and teal blue shadows deepen the black hair on the left. The flat neutral ground contains no buildings, props, or text. The composition leans upward and to the right through the taller figure's hair and lifted chin, while the left boy's wide eyes pull attention back across the pair. The color palette of red, orange, teal, ochre, and beige is warm and energetic. The finish is polished but slightly textured, giving the static pose the urgency of a youth adventure poster.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动漫插画把两位少年肩并肩置于简洁暖米色背景前。左边较矮的男孩留蓬乱近黑短发，有很大的圆形绿眼，双眼下各有几颗雀斑。他穿红色外套，内搭浅灰翻领衬衫和深领带。嘴紧闭，视线略向右上抬，显出担忧或警觉。右边较高的男孩稍站其后，占画面更多。他的橙红尖发以棱角层叠向外炸开，额前还部分叠着深红帽檐般或头带形状。他穿深青绿外套、亮赭黄衬衫、红领带，胸前有棕色肩带斜过。眉头定住，下巴上抬，神情自信而带挑战性。两人都在上半身附近被裁。他们肩部在视觉上贴近，却没有手势；关系靠近距离和不同表情传递。左脸圆而年少，右脸较窄且有棱角。干净深轮廓界定头发、眼、衣领和外套拼缝；暖调赛璐璐式阴影平面落在脸颊、颈和衣褶。亮橙高光穿过右边发丝，青蓝暗影使左侧黑发加深。平坦中性背景没有建筑、道具或文字。较高人物的发和抬高下巴让构图朝右上走，左边少年宽圆眼又把注意力拉回双人关系。红、橙、青绿、赭与米色的色盘暖而有劲。完成度精致却微带肌理，让静止姿势具有少年冒险海报的急迫感。
style_prompt_en: The energetic youth-anime treatment uses crisp varied outlines, exaggerated expressive eyes, pointed hair silhouettes, and warm cel-like shadow planes. A simple beige field isolates two overlapping forms and makes their contrasting heights and expressions immediately readable. Vermilion, orange, dark teal, ochre, and muted gray are arranged in broad clean blocks, with thin textural grain softening the flatness. Hair edges flare diagonally upward, while straps, collars, and folds create smaller directional accents. Highlights remain warm and selective, leaving strong shadow shapes under bangs and along jawlines. The composition feels like a character poster: still poses charged by facial focus, asymmetrical grouping, and a strong red-teal color opposition. No environmental detail is needed to support the graphic clarity.
style_prompt_zh: 有活力的少年动漫处理运用粗细变化的清利轮廓、夸张有表情的眼睛、尖锐发形剪影和暖调赛璐璐式阴影平面。简洁米色域隔离两处重叠形体，使高度和神情差异立即可读。朱红、橙、深青绿、赭与低饱和灰以宽阔干净色块安排，薄薄纹理颗粒缓和其平坦。发缘沿对角向上炸开，带、领与褶线构成较小方向重音。高光暖而有选择，刘海下与下颌边保留强阴影形。构图像角色海报：静姿由眼神焦点、不对称群组和鲜明红青对色充满张力。无需环境细节即可支撑图形清晰度。
theme_en: Two determined young anime boys pose closely in contrasting red and teal school clothes
theme_zh: 两位神情坚定的动漫少年穿红与青绿相对的校服紧靠站立
name: Shonen anime style
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
